A '''S.t.a.s.h chart''' can be built in the [[wall chart space]] of the [[study]] in a [[player-owned house]]. It requires 40 [[Construction]] to build and gives 16 [[experience]].

The chart acts as the equivalent of the [[Noticeboard (Watson's house)|noticeboard]] in [[Watson's house]], and players can check where all [[STASH|STASH unit]] locations are, and whether they have built and filled them.

==Trivia==
* '''S.T.A.S.H''' stands for "'''S'''tore '''T'''hings '''A'''nd '''S'''tuff '''H'''ere".
* Periods between letters are usually used for initialisms, where each letter is pronounced individually, however, S.T.A.S.H is pronounced as one word, like an acronym.
* This is the only item built in the wall chart space that provides any practical, game-related purpose, despite being the lowest tier item.
